reason: Provides persistent storage and runtime management for DeepSeek Harness dynamic plugins through AI-callable tools and web interface controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态插件的磁盘持久化、选择性加载及运行时管理功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with disk persistence, selective loading, and runtime management for dynamic plugins.

capabilities: Lists, imports, renames, deletes, and persists stored plugin packages
